_comment_source: Reverse-engineered 2026-09-24 from the diff between public origin/main (592c4c3) and pre-cut-release (b862900). Every path below either appears as an add-only ('A') entry in `git diff --name-status 592c4c3 pre-cut-release` (exclude list) or as a modified ('M') / deleted-from-592c4c3 ('D', i.e. add-back) entry that needed a transform to reproduce 592c4c3's exact content.
exclude: _comment_P2: 2026-09-24 Jax ruling -- this internal build spec (private product roadmap, mentions the paid-tier causal-memory core cluster) is not free-tier material, excluded outright not just sanitized. KNOWN INTENTIONAL divergence from today's origin/main (592c4c3), which still ships an older, unexcluded copy of this file -- byte-diff gate special-cases it, see knownDivergencesFromCurrentOriginMain below.

addFiles._comment: Present ONLY in 592c4c3 (public), absent from pre-cut-release -- pmm-isolation-gate.cjs's open-core cut extracted two pure Win32 filename-safety helpers out of the excluded pmm-core.cjs into this new leaf file so the gate stays self-contained.

overlays._comment: Full-content replace. Used where the private->public difference is a hand-curated narrative (README) or a dense, coupled data-file edit (guard-canary.sh's roster/EXPECTED arithmetic; isolation-gate-contract.json's allow_prod roster remap + 3 report_only downgrades + mutation-set trim) that is safer to snapshot than to re-derive mechanically. TRADEOFF (see report): these 4 files will need a manual overlay refresh whenever their private source gains new content for KEPT (non-excluded) guards -- the script does not auto-detect staleness.

replacements: _comment: each {file, findFile, replaceFile} pair does an exact, literal, whole-substring find/replace of findFile's content with replaceFile's content inside the exported copy of `file`. required=true (default) fails the export loudly if findFile's exact text is not found -- this is the forcing function that catches upstream drift instead of silently missing it.

sanitize._comment: Defense-in-depth regex scrub applied to every exported text file (not just the ones covered by replacements/overlays above), driven dynamically from the running machine's os.userInfo().username / os.hostname() -- never a hardcoded literal in this manifest or the script, so it stays correct if run from a different machine.

rules.description: the real OS username as a bare word (e.g. inside a JS string literal or comment) -> <user>

Desktop\axervice-booking or Desktop/axervice-booking, ONLY when immediately preceded by a real absolute-path username segment (not a $VAR reference and not an already-redacted <user> placeholder) -- deliberately scoped so it does NOT touch the pre-existing, already-public $HOMEW/Desktop/axervice-booking test fixtures in guards/pmm-trigger-recall.sh or the already-<user>-redacted mention in docs/audits/SURVEY-2026-09-17-live-vs-product.md (both byte-identical to today's origin/main; touching them would break the byte-identity gate over content Jax already accepted as public).

knownDivergencesFromCurrentOriginMain: docs/P2-CC-PERFECT-SPEC.md (now excluded per 2026-09-24 Jax ruling; current origin/main still ships an older, unexcluded copy -- see exclude[] comment above)

lib/msys-path.cjs, lib/atomic-write.cjs, adapters/claude-code/merge-hooks.cjs, lib/VENDOR.md (W7 fixes on pre-cut-release not yet in origin/main -- see build report for whether these are new-vs-592c4c3 or already-identical)
